key_notes: Key 1 (t=0.6s): Initial archival pose of roller-coaster; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=1.73s): Mid-sequence articulation of roller-coaster; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=2.96s): Peak dynamic extension of roller-coaster over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=4.2s): Follow-through and settle of roller-coaster with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of roller-coaster (0.6s..4.2s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.

source.rights_statement: Moving Image Archive / Public Domain & Archival Research Corpus

design_selection.why: Selected Quick, Draw! human doodle #9 (US, 5 strokes) matched by aspect ratio & structural contour compatibility.
design_selection.method: SCION + Zero-Shot Quick, Draw! Prototype Matcher (top-25 recognized human drawings)
